description: Crustaceans: live, fresh or chilled, n.e.c. in item no. 0306.3, in shell or not, including edible flours, meals, and pellets of crustaceans

Vegetable roots and tubers: arrowroot, salep, Jerusalem artichokes and similar roots and tubers (not manioc, sweet potatoes, yams, taro or yautia), high starch or inulin content, fresh, chilled, frozen, dried, sliced or not, or in pellet form: sago pith
Fabrics: warp knit (including those made on galloon knitting machines), other than those of headings 60.01 to 60.04, of cotton, yarns of different colours
Diamonds: whether or not worked, but not mounted or set, unsorted

Fish: fresh or chilled, trout (Salmo trutta, Oncorhynchus mykiss, Oncorhynchus clarki, Oncorhynchus aguabonita, Oncorhynchus gilae, Oncorhynchus apache and Oncorhynchus chrysogaster), excluding fillets, fish meat of 0304, and edible fish offal of 0302.9
Fish: fresh or chilled, n.e.c. in heading 0302, excluding fillets, fish meat of 0304, and edible fish offal of subheadings 0302.91 to 0302.99
Fish: fresh or chilled, fish fins (other than shark fins), heads, tails, maws and other edible fish offal
Vegetables: truffles and mushrooms (other than of the genus Agaricus), fresh or chilled

Fruit: cherries, prepared or preserved in ways n.e.c. in heading no. 2007, whether or not containing added sugar, other sweetening matter or spirit
Cigars, cigarillos and cheroots: containing tobacco substitutes including the weight of every band, wrapper or attachment thereto
Tobacco: other than homogenised or reconstituted or smoking
Slag, ash and residues: (not from the manufacture of iron or steel), containing mainly metals or their compounds, n.e.c. in heading no. 2620
Lead oxides: n.e.c. in heading no. 2824

Poly(vinyl acetate): in aqueous dispersion, in primary forms
Stones: rubies, sapphires and emeralds, worked (other than simply sawn or roughly shaped), not strung, mounted or set
Waste and scrap of precious metals: of gold, including metal clad with gold but excluding sweepings containing other precious metals
Copper: waste and scrap
Aluminium: unwrought, alloys
